turn_on_efficient_conv_bn_eval: turn on efficient conv batch norm fusion for specified submodules of a PyTorch model
turn_on_efficient_conv_bn_eval_for_singl: turn on efficient conv batch norm fusion for a single PyTorch nn.Module via FX tracing
efficient_conv_bn_eval_forward: run the fused conv and batch norm forward pass by folding BN statistics into conv weights
efficient_conv_bn_eval_control: run the control function that chooses fused forward in eval mode or standard conv then BN in training mode
efficient_conv_bn_eval_graph_transform: transform a PyTorch FX graph module to fuse consecutive conv and batch norm nodes into a single operation
